name: strengthen-mechanism-placement-six-proof-contract
title: Strengthen the pre-story Mechanism Placement Proof to answer all six allocation questions
description: Amend the existing architecture plan so a pre-story candidate cannot PROCEED merely from entrypoint, chain, existing-mechanism, hook, and minimum-change evidence. Add mandatory cause classification, active-Story relationship assessment, and development-conflict assessment, bind them to freshness and review, and define fail-closed verdict rules that answer all six user questions before Story ID allocation.
